Bengaluru plans mass dog sterilisation to address stray population

Bengaluru authorities are planning to sterilise approximately 90,000 stray dogs annually as part of a three-year strategy to achieve 100% coverage. This initiative aims to tackle the growing stray dog menace in the city. A state minister expressed frustration with officials over the issue, highlighting the urgency and challenges in managing the stray population.
